gloss: to go too far; to exceed the limit

definitions.gloss: to go too far; to exceed the proper limit
definitions.explanation: Describes behavior, actions, or situations that have passed an acceptable boundary. Often used critically to indicate that someone has overstepped.

examples.japanese: ⟦いたずら→いたずら：01794_itazura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{度|ど}を{越|こ}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The pranks have gone too far.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{度|ど}を{越|こ}すこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: His jokes sometimes go too far.

examples.japanese: {度|ど}を{越|こ}した⟦{飲酒|いんしゅ}→飲酒：08635_inshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: Excessive drinking is bad for your health.

notes:
USAGE:
{度|ど}を{越|こ}す expresses that something has exceeded reasonable limits. It carries a negative connotation and is often used as criticism or warning.

COMMON PATTERNS:
The past participle form {度|ど}を{越|こ}した is frequently used as a modifier before nouns (e.g., {度|ど}を{越|こ}した⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧ "excessive behavior").

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{度|ど}が{過|す}ぎる→度が過ぎる：19564_dogasugiru⟧ (to be excessive — similar meaning)
- ⟦やり→やる：02980_yaru⟧すぎる (to overdo it — more colloquial)
- ⟦{行|い}き→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧ (to go too far — focuses on actions)
